records.notes: Visible forms preserve الْأَدْبَارَ; initial alif and dagger-alif presentation differs.
Hafs visibly uses يَفْعَلُوا while the other editions use تَفْعَلُوا.
Hafs visibly uses يُكْفَرُوهُ while the other editions use تُكْفَرُوهُ.
Visible forms preserve طَائِفَتَانِ; standing-alif and stopping-mark presentation differs.
Warsh and Qalun visibly omit the initial waw in سَارِعُوا while the other editions retain وَسَارِعُوا.
